dream: My last stream was actually a nightmare. I was crawling in tight spaces and got stuck in a crevice. It was scary.
childhood_space:
I lived at the Montgomery Apartments in Albuquerque. We were on the top floor, and it had a floral couch in the living room. I would sit a lot on that couch. One summer I spent so much time on that couch my mom thought I was gonna get stuck to it.

It had two bedrooms, and we lived with my grandmother, my sister, and my mom. My grandma and I shared a bedroom. Yeah, she smoked a lot. It was a smaller apartment.
insomnia_behavior: I just lay there with my eyes closed, focused on my breathing and trying to relax my body. I ended up tossing and turning a lot. Sometimes I'll flip around so my head's on the foot side of the bed.
current_space: There's a wooden panel in this room, and one of the panels has an indent in it that I hadn't noticed before.
emotional_residue: Boredom. The feeling of melancholy grief.
secret: My mom used to sing me lullabies every night before bed.
